The '''Lava Fishing Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked in the {{LI|Magmafish}} collection at {{coll|Magmafish 6}}, {{coll|Magmafish 9}}, and {{coll|Magmafish 11}} with increasing capacity. The Small Lava Fishing Sack can hold {{Green|2,240}} of each item, the Medium Lava Fishing Sack can hold {{Green|6,720}} of each item, and the Large Lava Fishing Sack can hold {{Green|20,160}} of each item.
